import pysam,pandas as pd,numpy as np,time
v=pysam.VariantFile('https://1000genomes.s3.amazonaws.com/release/20130502/ALL.chr1.phase3_shapeit2_mvncall_integrated_v5a.20130502.genotypes.vcf.gz',index_filename='ALL.chr1.phase3_shapeit2_mvncall_integrated_v5a.20130502.genotypes.vcf.gz.tbi')

for pos in gwas.sort_values('P').index:
 if all(abs(pos-p)>1000000 for p in peaks):peaks.append(pos)
 if len(peaks)==12:break
for pos in peaks:
 positions=[];geno=[]; t=time.time()
 for rec in v.fetch('1',int(pos)-200000,int(pos)+200000):
  if rec.pos not in gwas.index or len(rec.alleles)"'!=2:continue
  positions.append(rec.pos);geno.append([sum(s['"'GT']) for s in rec.samples.values()])
 np.savez_compressed('block_%d.npz'%pos,pos=positions,geno=np.array(geno,dtype=np.int8),samples=list(v.header.samples))
 print(pos,len(positions),time.time()-t,flush=True)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd,glob
from scipy.stats import norm
panel=pd.read_csv('integrated_call_samples_v3.20130502.ALL.panel',sep='\\t').set_index('sample')
gwas=pd.read_csv('gwas.ancestry.q1.tsv.gz',sep='\\t').set_index('POS')
pops=['AFR','EUR','EAS','SAS','AMR']; totals=np.zeros((len(pops),4))
for file in sorted(glob.glob('block_*.npz')):
 x=np.load(file); g=gwas.loc[x['pos']]; z=norm.isf(g.P.to_numpy()/2); lead=np.nanargmax(z); p=panel.loc[x['samples']]
 out=[]
 for k,pop in enumerate(pops):
  gt=x['geno'][:,(p.super_pop==pop).to_numpy()].astype(float)
  gt-=gt.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True); sd=np.linalg.norm(gt,axis=1); gt/=np.maximum(sd[:,None],1e-10)
  rr=gt@gt.T; r=rr[:,lead]; use=np.isfinite(z)&(sd>0)
  err=np.mean((np.abs(r[use])*z[lead]-z[use])**2)
  ii,jj=np.triu_indices(len(z),1); keep=use[ii]&use[jj]&(abs(x['pos'][ii]-x['pos'][jj])<100000)&(abs(rr[ii,jj])>.8)
  ii=ii[keep];jj=jj[keep];rs=np.abs(rr[ii,jj])*.995
  # folded bivariate normal likelihood of absolute test statistics
  a=z[ii];b=z[jj];ll=-.5*np.log1p(-rs**2)-(a*a+b*b)/(2*(1-rs**2))+np.logaddexp(rs*a*b/(1-rs**2),-rs*a*b/(1-rs**2))
  totals[k]+=[err,1,np.sum((a-b)**2),len(a)]
  out.append(round(err,3))
 print(file,'leadZ',round(z[lead],2),'errors',out,flush=True)
print('POPS',pops,'avg lead error',totals[:,0]/totals[:,1],'high-LD pair diff',totals[:,2]/totals[:,3],flush=True)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd,glob
from scipy.stats import norm
panel=pd.read_csv('integrated_call_samples_v3.20130502.ALL.panel',sep='\\t').set_index('sample');gwas=pd.read_csv('gwas.ancestry.q1.tsv.gz',sep='\\t').set_index('POS')
pops=['AFR','EUR','EAS','SAS','AMR'];total=np.zeros(len(pops));ts=[]
for file in sorted(glob.glob('block_*.npz')):
 x=np.load(file); z=norm.isf(gwas.loc[x['pos']].P.to_numpy()/2); p=panel.loc[x['samples']]; rs=[]; valid=[]
 for pop in pops:
  gt=x['geno'][:,(p.super_pop==pop).to_numpy()].astype(float);gt-=gt.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True);sd=np.linalg.norm(gt,axis=1);gt/=np.maximum(sd[:,None],1e-10);rs.append(gt@gt.T);valid.append(sd>0)
 valid=np.all(valid,axis=0)&np.isfinite(z)
 ii,jj=np.triu_indices(len(z),1);keep=valid[ii]&valid[jj]&(abs(x['pos'][ii]-x['pos'][jj])<50000)&(np.max(np.abs(rs),axis=0)[ii,jj]>.5)
 ii=ii[keep];jj=jj[keep];a=z[ii];b=z[jj];scores=[]
 for r in rs:
  r=np.abs(r[ii,jj])*.98
  ll=-.5*np.log1p(-r*r)-(a*a+b*b)/(2*(1-r*r))+np.logaddexp(r*a*b/(1-r*r),-r*a*b/(1-r*r))+(a*a+b*b)/2
  scores.append(np.mean(ll))
 scores=np.array(scores);total+=scores;ts.append(scores)
 print(file,len(ii),np.round(scores,3),flush=True)
print(pops,np.round(total,3))
